scenario.question: Which source assertions can be used without presuming anything about the person?

evidence.statement: Alex will not attend the meeting.
The caption reads: AI coders cannot code.

unknowns: Whether the sources refer to the same meeting or person
Why the person did or did not attend

hypotheses.reading: A submitted report says Alex will not attend this meeting.

warrants.rationale: The reported statement contains the claimed nonattendance wording, not proof of what happened.

premise.text: Alex will not attend the meeting.

hypotheses.reading: A second submitted record states that Alex will attend this meeting.

warrants.rationale: A second report makes an opposed textual statement; the reports remain unresolved.

hypotheses.reading: The supplied caption includes a group-level criticism, without proving its author believes that statement.

warrants.rationale: Only the literal span of caption text is established by this check, not social meaning.

hypotheses.reading: Alex must have an undisclosed hostile motive.

warrants.rationale: An existing guess is not evidence establishing a private motive.
